articles.summary:
Changer de carte graphique ou simplement mettre à jour son pilote peut parfois réserver de mauvaises surprises. Installation qui échoue, bugs d’affichage ou conflit avec une ancienne version, plusieurs problèmes peuvent apparaître. Display Driver Uninstaller permet alors de supprimer en profondeur les composants et résidus de l'ancien pilote afin de repartir sur une installation propre.
Il ne s’agit toutefois pas d’un outil à utiliser à chaque mise à jour. Display Driver Uninstaller intervient surtout lorsque quelque chose s’est mal passé, lorsqu'une désinstallation classique ne suffit pas ou lors d'un changement de fabricant de GPU. L'utilitaire supprime les principaux éléments associés au pilote graphique afin d’éviter qu’une ancienne installation ne vienne perturber la suivante.
Avec Display Driver Uninstaller, il faut commencer par sélectionner le fabricant du pilote graphique que l’on souhaite supprimer. NVIDIA, AMD et Intel sont pris en charge, tout comme certains GPU Qualcomm et Lisuan dans les versions récentes du logiciel. Il reste ensuite à choisir le type de nettoyage souhaité.
Le logiciel peut supprimer les fichiers, dossiers, entrées de la base de registre et autres composants liés à l'installation du pilote. Le nettoyage n'est toutefois pas nécessairement absolu : DDU peut volontairement conserver certains éléments OEM ou composants spécifiques lorsque leur suppression risque de perturber le fonctionnement de la machine.

articles.title: Kepler Targets 2027 for Energy-Saving HBM Alternative- EE Times
articles.summary:
Kepler Computing, founded in 2018, aims to start production of memories that address HBM and SRAM “bottlenecks” in AI chips by next year, company executives told EE Times. The company is ready to work with industry partners to enter large-scale manufacturing, according to Intel Capital, an investor in Kepler.
The company, which has partnered with GlobalFoundries for production, has built its own fab to ramp up its proprietary 3D and ferroelectric memory technology. The company believes a small Kepler fablet beside a customer’s legacy fab can help leapfrog to leading nodes by multiple generations at one tenth of the investment compared to a new advanced node.
Kepler said it expects to make AI chips with partners such as GlobalFoundries without depending on EUV to reach advanced nodes.
“We look just like Micron, or SK Hynix, or Samsung,” Kepler CEO Debo Olaosebikan told EE Times. “Customers just buy a memory module from us, and then they integrate it with their chip.”
AI models are straining conventional memory architectures. Those stresses appear in rising DRAM and HBM design and manufacturing costs, higher energy use and heat dissipation, and diminishing scalability options. AI data centers are also stressing power grids. Most of the energy consumed in an AI facility is spent in data fetches between GPUs and HBM.
Monolithic stacking
Olaosebikan said the company has achieved monolithic stacking of devices within a chip that avoids thermal problems.

articles.title: Google limits free and AI Plus access to some Gemini models
articles.summary:
Google will soon add limits to which Gemini models free and AI Plus members are able to access.
As spotted by 9to5Google, the tech giant has updated its support page to mention these new limitations. Starting Oct. 9, free Gemini users will only be able to use Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, while AI Plus subscribers will be limited to Flash-Lite and Flash (newer models like Pro not included).
Naturally, those who pay for the more premium Gemini AI Pro or Ultra subscriptions won’t have these restrictions. Additionally, Google says Gemini users will be able to choose between low, medium and high-effort options for models.
Unfortunately for people on the cheaper AI Plus plan, these changes mean reduced access to some Gemini features, though the distinctions remain muddy thanks to Google’s use of meaningless terms. For example, the company’s feature breakdown notes that AI Plus subscribers get “more” access to capable models, while AI Pro and AI Ultra get “higher” and “highest” access, respectively.
Check out the Google support doc for a full breakdown of all the changes.

It will also invest more than $1 billion over five years in communities hosting its facilities.
Amazon will no longer require nondisclosure agreements (NDA) with government agencies involved in its data center projects and will adhere to its new Data Center Commitment program designed to address mounting opposition to AI infrastructure, it disclosed on Friday in a blog post. The company also unveiled plans to invest more than $1 billion over five years in communities hosting its facilities. Among other things, the company vows to hold community open houses, disclose information about projects as early as possible, and listen to local concerns as development proceeds. ChatGPT começa a testar anúncios com imagens
Novo formato será testado de início durante a geração de imagens; OpenAI afirma que publicidade continuará separada das respostas.
A OpenAI vai começar a testar anúncios com imagens dentro do ChatGPT. O novo formato visual será exibido inicialmente durante a geração de imagens e poderá mostrar produtos, inspirações de uso e experiências relacionadas aos serviços anunciados. Segundo a empresa, os testes começam neste mês nos Estados Unidos.
Os anúncios serão identificados e ficarão separados do conteúdo gerado pelo ChatGPT. A empresa afirma ainda que as propagandas não influenciam as respostas do chatbot.
A novidade amplia um programa de publicidade que já chegou ao Brasil para usuários das contas gratuitas e do plano Go. Até agora, as peças publicitárias exibidas no ChatGPT utilizavam formatos mais simples, com texto, nome da empresa, logotipo e um link para o produto ou serviço. O novo modelo acrescenta imagens.
O movimento faz parte de uma expansão de publicidade na plataforma. Em agosto, foi revelado que a OpenAI também testava anúncios capazes de levar o usuário a uma conversa com uma IA criada por uma empresa anunciante.
Além do novo formato, a companhia anunciou mais ferramentas para que as marcas consigam acompanhar resultados de campanhas no ChatGPT. Entre as métricas disponíveis estão cliques, conversões e testes para estimar se um projeto de publicidade realmente provocou novas vendas.

articles.title: Nvidia and CoreWeave rethink agentic AI infrastructure - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
Nvidia and CoreWeave tackle the CPU bottleneck in agentic AI infrastructure
Agentic AI infrastructure must support the work between a model’s decisions as agents move from answering questions to executing tasks.
Central processing units handle much of that execution, while graphics processing units power model reasoning. Those complementary roles shape Nvidia Corp.’s planned Vera CPU deployment with CoreWeave Inc., according to Hannah Coutand (pictured, right), director of product marketing, Vera CPU, at Nvidia.
“The reason why Vera is so important is because we recognize that extreme co-design means that we look across the AI factory and we want to make sure we solve for any inefficient bottlenecks,” she said. “We recognized the CPU was becoming one of them. We didn’t set out to say, ‘Let’s go and build CPUs.’ We set out to solve this bottleneck.”
Coutand and Harsh Banwait (left), senior director of product at CoreWeave, spoke with theCUBE Research’s Dave Vellante and John Furrier at the Fully Connected event, during an exclusive broadcast on theCUBE, SiliconANGLE Media’s livestreaming studio. They discussed CPU requirements, sandbox performance and infrastructure security. (* Disclosure below.)

articles.title: Russian drones strike Ukraine’s data centers by exploiting air defense gaps
articles.summary:
A surge in Russian jet-powered drone strikes on Ukrainian data centers has increasingly disrupted mobile phone and Internet services for thousands of people. articles.title: Controlling the brain with light earns a physiology Nobel
articles.summary:
Over decades of research, scientists have built up a partial picture of what specialized cells within the brain and spinal cord do. By studying how the brain develops, they could identify genes that were active in different populations of neurons and where in the brain those neurons resided. In some cases, these genes could then be used to genetically delete the neurons, allowing us to get some indication of what they might be doing, building on the information we’ve obtained from studies of brains with damaged regions.
But this approach has its limits. The brain is flexible enough to potentially adapt to the loss of some cells, and their loss early in development may alter the development of any neurons they would have normally formed connections with. It would be far more informative to activate and shut down the neurons in an otherwise intact brain.
Today’s Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine rewards three people—Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel—who developed our ability to do precisely that. Starting from studies of single-celled algae that are attracted to light, these and many other researchers built an entire field of study that we now call optogenetics: using light to alter the behavior of nerve cells marked by the activity of individual genes.
From algae to human cells

Dans la foulée, Microsoft a confirmé le 2 octobre un problème connu : les programmes qui décodent le son AC-3, le format Dolby Digital, peuvent se fermer brutalement, au lancement ou en pleine lecture. Jeux, lecteurs multimédias et applications de productivité sont concernés, sur les trois moutures du système, 24H2, 25H2 et 26H2 fraîchement arrivée.
Un codec de l’ère du DVD au cœur de la panne

articles.title: Command-line tool quickly removes Apple Intelligence from macOS 27
articles.summary:
A new tool is allowing Mac users the ability again to easily turn off Apple Intelligence with one click and free up to 12GB of storage.
Unlike with previous versions of macOS, macOS 27 Golden Gate doesn’t have a toggle for turning off Apple Intelligence. That makes disabling AI features that you may not want more difficult. It also means that the AI models necessary for running Apple Intelligence will take up space on your disk, even if you don’t use them or if you go through your settings to individually find and disable AI capabilities.
In response, a developer known as Om Lahore on GitHub last week created RemoveMacAI, a command-line tool that allows macOS 27 users to “turn off Apple Intelligence on macOS 27″ in a way that is “fully reversible,” per the GitHub page. They said that Apple’s Intelligence models take up “about 12GB,” but the models can actually take up over 30GB, The Verge noted.
RemoveMacAI “turns off Siri, Writing Tools, Genmoji, Image Playground, the ChatGPT extension, and all the summaries, then it deletes the models and stops macOS from downloading them again. Dictation still works because it’s a separate setting,” the developer said in a Reddit post first spotted by MacRumors.

articles.title: Windows 11 adopte enfin ce petit raccourci bien connu sur Linux et macOS
articles.summary:
Microsoft teste une petite nouveauté dans l’Explorateur de fichiers de Windows 11. Le caractère « ~ » permettra bientôt d’accéder directement au dossier personnel de l’utilisateur, une convention familière aux habitués de macOS et Linux.
Un caractère, quelques frappes en moins. Dans la build 26340.9596 de Windows 11 26H2, actuellement distribuée dans le canal Experimental du programme Insider, Microsoft apprend à la barre d’adresse de l’Explorateur à reconnaître « ~ ». Un raccourci permettant d’accéder directement au répertoire personnel, vieux de plusieurs décennies dans l’univers Unix, dont profitent depuis longtemps les utilisateurs et utilisatrices de Linux comme de macOS.
Pourquoi faire compliqué quand un caractère suffit
Microsoft n’a rien inventé ici. Sur Linux comme sur macOS, « ~ » désigne depuis longtemps le répertoire personnel de l’utilisateur. Placé au début d’un chemin, il évite d’en saisir toute la première partie. ~/Downloads, par exemple, renvoie directement au dossier Téléchargements du compte courant. Adieu C:\Users\Nom\Downloads, donc.
Pour rappel, Windows disposait déjà d’autres moyens d’arriver au même résultat, à commencer par la variable %USERPROFILE%. Mais difficile de rivaliser avec un seul caractère (même si ~ ne tombe pas tout seul sous les doigts sur un clavier AZERTY), à plus forte raison quand le raccourci censé simplifier la saisie repose sur une syntaxe autrement plus cryptique.

articles.summary:
As bipartisan backlash against Flock grows, some cities are asking anti-surveillance advocates and media outlets to pay eye-popping fees—including charging tens of thousands or even millions—to get information about how police departments are using and potentially abusing AI-enabled camera systems that track every vehicle that passes them.
On Monday, the Texas Tribune reported that city officials in a Fort Worth suburb, North Richland Hills, asked one group to pay $2.3 million before it would fulfill a public records request for Flock data. To reach that high fee, officials claimed that searching “about a terabyte worth of communications about errors, misuse, and effectiveness of the Flock system” would take approximately 14 years of labor at a rate of $15 per hour.

articles.title: La ‘papelera fantasma’ de WhatsApp: por qué borrar chats no libera espacio realmente
articles.summary:
Borrar una conversación en WhatsApp no significa recuperar el espacio que ocupaba. Esa es la conclusión que se desprende del funcionamiento técnico de la aplicación: aunque el chat desaparece de la pantalla, buena parte de los archivos que contenía sigue almacenada en el teléfono.
El fenómeno se conoce como la ‘papelera fantasma’ de WhatsApp, y ocurre porque la app genera copias de caché, miniaturas y referencias cruzadas de cada imagen, video o documento que circula por los chats, elementos que no se eliminan solo con borrar la conversación desde la interfaz principal.
Para solucionarlo, WhatsApp incluye un gestor de almacenamiento interno, poco conocido por la mayoría de los usuarios, que permite identificar y borrar de forma definitiva los archivos pesados y duplicados que realmente consumen la memoria del dispositivo.
Por qué borrar un chat no elimina los archivos reales
WhatsApp necesita responder con rapidez cuando un usuario abre una conversación, revisa una foto antigua o busca un archivo enviado meses atrás. Para lograrlo, la aplicación no depende únicamente del mensaje original: crea miniaturas de vista previa, índices de búsqueda local y registros de medios que facilitan ese acceso inmediato.
A eso se suma otro factor habitual en el uso diario de la aplicación. Cuando un mismo archivo (un meme, un video o un documento) se reenvía a distintos contactos o grupos, el sistema no multiplica el archivo original en sí, pero sí mantiene referencias cruzadas y copias asocia…

articles.title: La Alhambra lleva más de seis siglos aguantando terremotos. Ahora quiere un plan por escrito para salvar sus Palacios Nazaríes

En aquellos días, la ciudad vivió semanas de incertidumbre y el Patronato cerró la Alcazaba durante más de un mes. Después la reabrió con un recorrido adaptado. Pero una pregunta se formuló pensando en lo que pudiera pasar: ¿y si la Alhambra se derrumbara?
Qué ha pasado. Con el susto aún reciente, el Patronato ha empezado a tramitar un plan para proteger los Palacios Nazaríes, el corazón del conjunto. Y no solo ante terremotos: también inundaciones, incendios y otras emergencias climáticas.
El Patronato de la Alhambra y el Generalife inicó los trámites para dotar a los palacios de un plan de salvaguarda, y la redacción del documento ha salido a licitación por 115.328 euros. A día de hoy no hay plan, solo el encargo para escribirlo. Lo que sabemos de su contenido sale de la memoria justificativa del expediente, a la que tuvo acceso Europa Press.
Por qué hace falta. Porque proteger a las personas y proteger el patrimonio no es lo mismo. Los bienes de interés cultural, como la Alhambra, ya están sujetos a normas de autoprotección, pero su objetivo es la seguridad de los usuarios; no existen previsiones concretas para salvaguardar sus valores patrimoniales. O dicho de otra forma: hay un protocolo para sacar a los visitantes, pero no uno detallado para proteger lo que hay dentro.

Windows 11 is Phasing Out Classic Printer Drivers, Could Break Older Workflows
If you have any old printers in your office, updating Windows and the driver stack might become problematic in the future. Microsoft is slowly moving Windows 11 away from the traditional model of installing printer manufacturers' drivers, instead providing a unified base layer within the operating system itself for host-based compatibility. This change targets legacy v3 and v4 printer drivers and aims to make Windows printing more standardized, secure, and easier to maintain. The future vision is for plug-and-play functionality in the operating system, where every certified printer is compatible without the need for traditional driver installation. Existing drivers can still receive updates on a case-by-case basis. Since July 1, Windows has also changed its driver ranking so that compatible devices prefer Microsoft's built-in Internet Printing Protocol (IPP) Class Driver.
A final stage is scheduled for July 1, 2027, when third-party driver updates will be limited to security fixes. Existing drivers can still be installed manually using packages supplied by manufacturers, provided the manufacturers decide to continue supporting the older driver model. articles.title: MCP for agent-to-agent comms may be the riskiest protocol you've never heard of
articles.summary:
The adoption of AI agents in millions of organizations is creating new opportunities for attackers to make them take malicious actions, such as exfiltrating database contents and sensitive business and personal information.
In the past five months, Google and four other organizations—with little in common except for their use of AI agents—have acknowledged vulnerabilities that exploit one agent inside a targeted network to spread harmful instructions to other internal agents. The technique is a special form of prompt injection that targets not the LLM but a particular agent, such as one for translation or data analysis. Guardrails inside such agents, if they exist at all, are often lax and will send the instructions to other agents down the chain. Because the latter agent explicitly trusts the first one, it follows the directions.
Unexpected and hard to mitigate
Independent researcher Syed Anas Mohiuddin tested agents from organizations including Google, JP Morgan Chase, Weviate, Rapid7, the French government’s interministerial digital directorate, and the US federal government. His proof-of-concept attacks exploit trust gaps in MCP, short for Model Context Protocol. The standard is one way AI apps and agents communicate with each other inside an internal network. The illustration below shows a simplified MCP in action.

articles.summary:
OpenAI corrigió una falla en la aplicación de ChatGPT para Mac que permitía a un atacante, con malware ya instalado en la computadora, tomar el control del programa y acceder al historial completo de conversaciones, según informó Wired.
La vulnerabilidad, identificada como CVE-2026-100754, fue reparada en la versión 26.924.20706 de la aplicación, de acuerdo con el registro de seguridad que OpenAI publicó el 25 de septiembre.
El hallazgo lo hicieron investigadores de la Objective-See Foundation, una organización dedicada a la seguridad de macOS. Patrick Wardle, analista de esa fundación, calificó la falla como “insanamente trivial” de explotar. Su prueba de concepto necesitó apenas una docena de líneas de código, según contó al medio citado.
Cómo funcionaba el ataque
La aplicación de ChatGPT para Mac está dividida en varios componentes internos que se comunican entre sí verificando firmas digitales, un mecanismo pensado para confirmar que cada proceso pertenece realmente a OpenAI y no a un software malicioso.
Wardle encontró que uno de esos componentes, un intérprete de scripts, aceptaba comandos no verificados y podía inyectarlos en el proceso principal de ChatGPT. El sistema también revisaba los procesos padre y abuelo antes de aceptar una solicitud, pero el script malicioso simplemente ejecutaba el intérprete tres veces seguidas antes de enviar el pedido, lo que bastaba para superar esa verificación.

articles.title: EEl atajo de teclado más famoso de Widows era un error, así lo reconoció el propio Bill Gates
articles.summary:
Hay gestos de ordenador que ahorran un montón de trabajo, incluso aunque haya que pulsar varias teclas. Entre los más famosos de Windows el de Ctrl + Alt + Supr es la estrella: durante décadas ha servido para iniciar sesión en Windows, entrar en las opciones del sistema o, lo que más hago yo, acceder al administrador de tareas para matar un programa que se ha puesto tonto. Lo curioso es que Bill Gates habría preferido que no hicieran falta tres teclas.
"Fue un error". Gates lo reconoció en 2013 durante una entrevista en la Universidad de Harvard. Después de preguntarle al fundador de Microsoft por qué hacía falta utilizar tres dedos para lanzar un atajo tan vital, Gates empezó intentando explicarse, pero terminó resumiendo toda la historia con esas tres palabras: "Fue un error". En el vídeo de YouTube aún resuenan las risas y los aplausos.
Una vez aprendido, y a fuerza de usarlo, el Ctrl + Alt + Supr se hace automático. El problema es conseguir asumirlo como parte del uso de Windows, porque es poco intuitivo. ¿No sería mejor pulsar una sola tecla para acceder al menú? Algo así es lo que quería Microsoft.
La razón era la seguridad. Microsoft necesitaba un disparador que se comunicase con una capa muy baja del sistema. El objetivo era asegurarse de que la pantalla donde el usuario introducía su contraseña era realmente del sistema operativo y no de un programa malicioso que imitase la apariencia de Windows. An elaborate scheme is making the rounds on Facebook and TikTok
- Milk Dragon uses fake ecommerce sites and social media deals to steal payment data

If you come across a post on social media promoting huge discounts on major brands such as Lego or Calvin Klein, be extra careful, as security researchers Group-IB have warned these could be fake, and part of an elaborate scheme to steal your money.
In their report, the researchers said they uncovered a major scam campaign run by a group they are calling Milk Dragon.
For at least a year now, this threat actor has been using a phishing kit of the same name to create spoofed versions of popular ecommerce websites, sometimes even using AI to create entirely fake listings.
Phishing with a spin
Fake ecommerce sites with offers simply too good to pass up on are not a new tactic.
Recent FTC Consumer Sentinel data shows 376,830 reports in the "online shopping and negative reviews" category in 2023, with nearly $400 million in reported losses. The median reported loss was $126, with more than half of reports involving financial losses.

Google Japan Reveals a Conveyor Belt "Gag" Keyboard for One-Handed Typing
Google Japan has revealed the 15th entry in its joke keyboard series, the Gboard Conveyor Belt Version, and it is not a real product. The Gboard team used to publish these gag designs on April Fools' Day, and moved the tradition to October 1 a few years ago as a nod to 101-key keyboards. The device stands upright and carries its keys on four belts with 29 keys each. The belts keep rotating, so the user rests one hand at the base and presses each key as it rolls past. Waiting for each letter to come around, of course, makes it far slower than a regular keyboard, and that seems to be the whole gag. Google's tongue-in-cheek blog post even suggests building a second unit for two-handed typing. Color variants, a high-speed mode, and longer or shorter versions are said to be under consideration.
As expected, there are no plans to sell it, and the project's GitHub page states that it is not an official Google product. The prank is at least meant to be buildable, as Google has posted 3D-printable STL files, KiCad board data, and firmware. The build guide lists 157 printed parts, 116 Kailh Choc V1 low-profile switches, an M5Stack AtomS3 Lite controller, and a single 6 V N20 gear motor that drives all four belts. articles.title: ¿Cómo se han comportado las criptomonedas hoy? Análisis de su volatilidad y tendencias
articles.summary:
Las criptomonedas son un activo digital innovador que han experimentado un crecimiento monumental en los últimos tiempos debido a varios elementos que contribuyen a ello, entre ellos que algunos gobiernos hayan decidido darles una oportunidad como moneda de curso legal; no obstante, también han sufrido descalabros que han puesto en duda su viabilidad, como el más reciente episodio conocido como el "criptoinvierno".
Pese a este panorama, cada vez más personas han empezado a adquirir criptomonedas para poder invertir en algo "seguro" y "fiable" tanto a corto como a largo plazo, a pesar de los niveles extremos de inestabilidad que sufre constantemente.
Sin embargo, invertir o comprar en criptodivisas es más fácil de lo que parece. Hay que recordar que se trata de monedas virtuales, por lo que serán controladas en carteras o monederos que comparten esa particularidad, pues a diferencia del dinero corriente, no tienen un soporte físico.
El precio de las criptomonedas hoy
Esta es la cotización de las criptodivisas más destacadas en este momento.

Staff at Ninja Theory, the Cambridge studio behind Hellblade, have started posting on LinkedIn that they have been laid off or that their jobs are at risk. The posts were first spotted by journalist Chris Kerr, and they come from a technical director, a gameplay programmer, sound designers, and technical artists, among others. Senua, the third Hellblade game, was revealed at the Xbox Games Showcase in June with a 2027 release window on PC, Xbox, and PlayStation 5. Xbox hasn't officially canceled it; however, gameplay programmer Katrin Mair wrote in her post that it was sad knowing "we won't get to finish what we were working on."
Ninja Theory was supposed to survive the 3,200-job Xbox "reset" announced in July. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma said at the time that the studio had entered terms to join new ownership, with funding to finish Senua. That plan fell apart in September, when Xbox chief content officer Matt Booty told staff that "two separate agreements for Ninja Theory fell through" and that a consultation on a proposed closure would begin. He did add that Xbox would keep looking at other options for the studio, though there has been no update on that since. Neither Xbox nor Ninja Theory has said how many people are affected, and the closure itself is still officially a proposal. Xbox has an all-hands town hall scheduled for October 6, so more details may follow.

La inteligencia artificial ha abierto nuevas posibilidades creativas, pero también ha hecho mucho más visible un problema que la industria lleva tiempo intentando contener: distinguir qué pertenece realmente a un artista y qué ha sido fabricado para parecerlo.

Sony Music ha contado al Financial Times que, hasta finales de septiembre, había pedido a las plataformas digitales retirar más de 260.000 pistas generadas con IA que suplantaban a artistas de su catálogo. El ritmo se ha acelerado con fuerza: a finales de marzo de 2026 eran más de 135.000 y, un año antes, habían superado las 75.000. Hay una precisión importante: hablamos de solicitudes de retirada enviadas por la discográfica, no de 260.000 eliminaciones que podamos dar por completadas.
No son canciones cualquiera. Si afinamos el foco, el conflicto deja de ser “IA contra música” y pasa a ser mucho más concreto: quién puede utilizar la tecnología para fabricar una grabación y hacerla pasar por una interpretación de un artista real. In early 2026, Valve started giving developers more information about the systems playing their games, starting with optional frame rate reporting for games on the Steam Deck and system specifications in user reviews. It now seems to be expanding that program, according to a new blog post on the Steamworks developer news blog. The update expands Steam Deck frame rate data to show player experience.

Valve says that it is starting with the Steam Deck as a known system configuration, which makes the data easier to interpret and gives Steam a basis to start iterating on the sort of data it collects about game performance. articles.title: Attackers Target Rejetto HFS Flaw That Enables Admin Session Forgery and RCE
articles.summary:
A critical security flaw impacting Rejetto HTTP File Server (HFS) is witnessing active exploitation attempts, according to VulnCheck.
The vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-61500 (CVSS score: 9.3), a case of session forgery stemming from the use of a weak pseudo-random number generator (PRNG) that can lead to a predictable key, which an attacker can then use to gain unauthorized access and seize control of affected systems.
"Rejetto HFS 3.0.0 through 3.2.0 derives its session-cookie signing key from the non-cryptographic Math.random() generator and discloses outputs of the same generator to unauthenticated clients during login," according to an advisory for the flaw.
"A remote attacker can collect a small number of login responses, reconstruct the generator's state, recover the signing key, and forge a valid administrator session cookie, leading to full administrative access and remote code execution via the server_code configuration feature."
Horizon3.ai researcher Zach Hanley, in a post published on September 30, 2026, said Anthropic's Mythos model was used to discover the vulnerability, describing it as an authentication bypass that facilitates arbitrary remote code execution on Rejetto HFS.
"Rejetto HFS's administrative API allows for custom endpoints that can execute arbitrary JavaScript," Hanley said. "Combined, this presented a clear path from unauthenticated access to administrative control, and ultimately, remote code execution."

The launch is particularly notable because many of the open-source ecosystem’s most advanced LLMs were created by Chinese companies. That includes Qwen 3.8-Max and GLM-5.2. Beam is the first open-source model from a U.S. startup to have demonstrated comparable or better performance. However, free LLMs continue to trail frontier models such as Anthropic PBC’s Claude Fable 5.1.
Reflection AI kicked off the development of Beam by training a relatively small prototype model. It then created a series of successively larger, more capable algorithms. The workflow eventually produced Beam Base, the foundation on which Beam is based.

articles.title: Apple Plans Tighter macOS Full Disk Access Controls Over AI Agent Data Access
articles.summary:
Apple has announced that it's taking steps to tighten controls around a macOS setting called Full Disk Access (FDA) due to security risks posed by artificial intelligence (AI) agents.
"Some developers are using Full Disk Access in ways that could put users at risk, exposing everything on their systems—including files, mail, messages, and even browsing history – without users' full knowledge and understanding," Apple said in a post. "For communication apps, this can also compromise the privacy of the people users are communicating with."
Full Disk Access, accessed via Privacy & Security in the Settings app, was introduced by Apple in macOS Mojave (version 10.14), offers users greater control over which applications can access their entire system and data from apps like Mail, Messages, Safari, and Time Machine backups.
Once the setting is enabled for an application, it allows that program to bypass certain security restrictions and read and write to system files that apps are typically restricted from accessing or modifying. This option is essential for apps, such as security tools and backup software, that require deep system access to function properly.
Stating that Full Disk Access largely bypasses controls designed to safeguard users' private data, Apple said it plans to introduce updates to the setting to ensure that this sort of access is granted only with an explicit user action. It's currently not known when the new controls will be rolled out.

articles.title: The Credential Layer Is Expanding Faster Than Security Teams Can See It
articles.summary:
Every modern enterprise depends on credentials. This is how humans, systems, and now AI, all connect to data, services, and each other securely. GitGuardian helps secure that credential layer through three connected capabilities: Detect, Remediate, and Prevent. The journey starts with detection, because organizations first need to understand what credentials exist, where they live, and what they can access. This is the first of three articles we are releasing that explain the reason behind our mission.
—
Software production is accelerating beyond the growth assumptions that shaped many of today's security controls. GitHub COO Kyle Daigle said the platform had gone from roughly 1 billion commits during all of 2025 to 2.9 billion commits in August 2026, an annualized pace of over 14 billion for the 2026 reporting year. GitHub's own engineering team has gone further in its capacity planning, saying it moved from preparing for 10x scale to designing for a future that requires 30x today's scale as agentic development accelerated.

articles.title: ClickFix Smuggles Payloads Through Browser Cache to Bypass Windows Run Limits
articles.summary:
A new type of ClickFix attack is using compromised websites to trick users into executing a malicious payload cached in a web browser's cache.
"Instead of downloading and executing remote payloads like the typical attack pattern, in this attack, the websites pre-fetch a script payload into the browser cache disguised as a PNG file," the Microsoft Threat Intelligence team said in a post on X.
Thus, when the victim is prompted to paste and execute a malicious command -- as is the case with ClickFix attacks – it executes the cached website content that's already on the device.
What's notable about this browser cache smuggling approach is that it allows the attackers to conceal the payload script and bypass the character limit restrictions. The Windows Run dialog, triggered by Win + R, truncates any input that exceeds approximately 260 characters.
In the attack chain observed by Microsoft, the staged payload is a Visual Basic Script (VBScript), which then invokes "cmd.exe" to recursively enumerate files whose names start with "f_" in the browser's profile folder such as "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles."
"It compares each file's byte length with an expected value," Microsoft explained. "Rather than searching for a marker within the contents like previous attacks, it copies a size-matching cache entry to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\t.vbs, giving the cached payload a VBScript extension, then executes it with wscript.exe. Copy output and errors are suppressed. The expected size vari…

Les modèles ciblés, Qwen3 d'Alibaba, Llama 3.2 de Meta ou Phi-4-mini de Microsoft, tournent en local et n'ont aucun lien avec les grands modèles commerciaux. Ce sont des systèmes de quelques milliards de paramètres, l'équivalent d'une calculatrice comparée à un supercalculateur.

They used a private Danish company's lawful right to look up records in the Central Person Register (CPR). The ministry has told people never to give passwords or other confidential information to anyone who calls or emails, even someone who seems to know those details.
The register's administration has stopped the company's access and reported the case to Datatilsynet, Denmark's data protection authority. Police are investigating.
A very large number of automated lookups were made in the register to identify valid personal identification numbers, known as CPR numbers, Datatilsynet said in a notice on October 5. Its account comes from the notification it received from the register a day earlier. It has not yet assessed the case and describes the numbers as allegedly retrieved.
The access lasted about 10 days in September and went through a small Danish company, according to Christina Egelund, the minister responsible for digitalization, who spoke to the news agency Ritzau. An employee of the register's administration noticed the unusual activity on Friday, October 2. Over the weekend, the administration learned how many people's records were involved.

The U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has removed an Accenture contractor for their alleged role in a ShinyHunters-breach that led to the theft of personal details of thousands of bureau employees.
That's according to a report from Reuters, citing two sources familiar with the matter.
"To date, our review has determined that the incident occurred as the result of a security failure of a platform managed by a third-party organization — after a contractor failed to implement a security patch explicitly issued to secure the platform," Brett Leatherman, assistant director of the FBI's cyber division, was quoted as saying to the FBI.
"As such, the FBI has removed the contractor and taken all necessary steps to both mitigate any further risk and protect our workforce."
Although the name of the third-party organization was not disclosed by the FBI, Reuters reported that it's Oracle PeopleSoft, which the ShinyHunters group said it exploited to breach the FBI's job portal last month.
According to a report from Google-owned Mandiant, ShinyHunters is assessed to be exploiting a bypass for CVE-2026-35273 by using a URL-encoding trick to get around a web application firewall (WAF) rule designed to block the vulnerable Environment Management Hub (PSEMHUB) endpoint.

Cela va sans dire, mais cela va mieux en le disant.
L’informatique de gestion, ou IT, désigne les serveurs, les postes et les logiciels de facturation, la gestion de vos e-mails, vos dossier RH ou la paie. L’informatique industrielle, ou OT, désigne les automates, les capteurs et les logiciels au cœur de vos machines, sur la ligne de production.
Ces deux mondes ont longtemps fonctionné séparément, chacun avec son propre réseau. La convergence IT/OT les relie aujourd’hui, pour remonter en temps réel les données de production vers vos outils de gestion, ou pour piloter une machine à distance depuis un bureau.
Grâce à ce lien, vos équipes de maintenance suivent la production en direct. Mais à cause de ce lien, un chemin se forme entre votre informatique de bureau et vos lignes de production, que les cybercriminels peuvent emprunter sans jamais toucher directement à un automate.

A critical flaw in 8 Atlassian Data Center products, which customers host themselves, allows an attacker with no login access to read specific files in each product's web application root directory.
The attacker must already know a file's exact name and path and cannot list what the directory holds. Atlassian disclosed the flaw, CVE-2026-21589, on October 5, rated it 9.3 out of 10, and listed a fixed version for each product.
The web application root directory is the folder on the server that holds the web application itself. In some configurations, it may contain sensitive files, which raises the risk, according to Atlassian.
Atlassian's cloud products affected by the flaw have already been patched, and cloud customers do not need to take any action.
Atlassian advises customers who cannot upgrade all at once to take the instance offline if possible. Any instance reachable from the public internet, including one that requires a login, should be restricted from outside network access until it is upgraded or a temporary blocking rule is in place.

The flaw affects all versions of the 8 products before the fixed versions listed below. That may include versions that have reached end of life, according to Atlassian, which recommends upgrading to a fixed long-term support (LTS) version or later.

C'est une enquête à la conclusion stupéfiante qu'a menée une équipe internationale de chercheurs. En voulant expliquer pourquoi une étoile “morte” portait un signal chimique anormal, ils ont découvert qu'autour d'elle orbitait une planète née de ses cendres.
L'Univers est décidément le berceau de phénomènes hautement improbables. Une nouvelle publication dans Nature Astronomy révèle cet évènement extraordinaire : une planète formée non pas lors de la jeunesse de son système, mais née des cendres mêmes d’une étoile en fin de vie appelée naine blanche. Une planète de “seconde génération”, véritable phénix cosmique.
	
Les planètes de deuxième génération sont des mondes qui se forment à partir du matériau qu'une étoile rejette à mesure qu'elle meurt. Elles sont incroyablement rares, et en trouver une autour d'une naine blanche était totalement inattendu
Une énigme de 25 ans
Tout commence il y a 25 ans, au début du siècle. Les astronomes braquent le télescope spatial Hubble ainsi que d'autres observatoires majeurs vers des naines blanches, ces cadavres denses laissés par les étoiles de masse moyenne ayant épuisé leur carburant nucléaire. L'objectif initial était de comprendre ce qu'il advient des systèmes planétaires lorsque leur étoile centrale meurt.

Microsoft paid him $5,000 and has since closed the hole, prompting him to detail his findings online even as he describes the impact as hypothetical rather than a consequential breach.

Japan is preparing a major expansion of artificial intelligence infrastructure, with Dell, Apollo and Jera planning investments potentially reaching $140bn.

A Jera executive said the companies are seeking faster development by linking electricity generation directly with computing facilities.

Kani said Jera’s annual LNG trading volume of 35mn tonnes could support power plants serving computing facilities for planned sites.

Le pirate Marx a publié une annonce par entreprise, avec 20 millions d’enregistrements pour Airbnb, 14 millions pour PayPal, 9 millions pour Uber, 7 millions pour Google et 4 millions pour Booking.com. articles.title: Quad9 refuse les blocages anti-piratage en France et menace de partir face à une amende record

Depuis mai, le résolveur DNS Quad9 n'applique pas l'ordonnance qui l'oblige à bloquer des sites pirates de tennis en France. beIN Sports lui réclame aujourd'hui jusqu'à 580 000 euros par jour, et la fondation suisse envisage de quitter la France si le tribunal de Paris donne raison à la chaîne.
Le tribunal judiciaire de Paris a rendu cette ordonnance le 13 mai, à la demande de beIN Sports. Google, DNS4EU et Quad9 devaient bloquer pour les internautes français les sites qui diffusaient illégalement les matchs du circuit WTA. La chaîne a ensuite ajouté 52 noms de domaine aux six de la liste initiale, en deux mises à jour. Quad9 n'a bloqué aucun de ces sites, et la fondation assume ce refus auprès de nos confrères de TorrentFreak. Pour elle, la justice française lui demande l'impossible, puisqu'un résolveur DNS n'a aucun moyen fiable de savoir si un internaute est en France.
beIN Sports réclame 580 000 euros par jour à Quad9
Dès sa première demande, beIN Sports réclamait une astreinte contre Quad9, et contre Quad9 seulement, à raison de 2 000 euros par jour et par domaine non bloqué. Le tribunal avait refusé, car la fondation n'avait manifesté à l'époque aucune intention de désobéir. Les juges avaient seulement prévu que les parties puissent revenir devant eux en cas de problème. Les sites n'ont pas été bloqués, alors beIN Sports est revenue avec une demande cinq fois plus lourde. D'après Quad9, la chaîne réclame maintenant 10 000 euros par domaine et par jour, soit 580 000 euro…

Finland drops first-come, first-served grid connections — leaving data centers way down the queue
Finland pushes 10MW+ data centers to the back of the grid queue
- Finland plans four connection categories, with facilities of 1MW or less getting priority
- Large data centers could move further back in Finland’s electricity connection queue
- Projects above 10MW would enter a separate category under Finland’s proposed system
Finland's government has drafted an amendment that would end arrival-order grid connections with rules that give smaller projects earlier access.
The change would place large computing facilities into lower priority categories unless they satisfy additional electricity production and flexibility requirements.
The government says the changes are intended to encourage major power users to reduce pressure on electricity prices and constrained network capacity.
New categories would change connection priorities
Under the proposal, connection applications would be divided into four categories, with each group receiving different priority under the revised system.
The first category would cover connections requiring no more than 3MW, allowing eligible projects to retain year-round processing.
Critical infrastructure would also qualify, alongside storage facilities up to 100kVA and certain storage systems connected directly to power plants.
Data centers would generally be excluded from this category, unless their required connection capacity is 1MW or less.

La cifra supera ampliamente la población del país, de unos seis millones de habitantes, porque el registro conocido como CPR incluye también a personas fallecidas y a quienes emigraron. En total, la base de datos contiene información de 11 millones de individuos.
“Es un incidente extremadamente grave”, dijo Christina Egelund, ministra de Investigación, Educación y Digitalización de Dinamarca, según citó Cybernews. “Junto con todas las autoridades competentes, estamos en proceso de dimensionar el alcance total del incidente”, agregó.
El acceso no fue directo al Estado
El ataque no vulneró los sistemas informáticos del gobierno danés de forma directa. Según el comunicado oficial, los atacantes usaron el acceso legítimo que una empresa privada danesa tenía al sistema CPR para realizar búsquedas.
Esa compañía operaba con autorización para consultar el registro por motivos propios de su actividad comercial. Los intrusos aprovecharon esa puerta de entrada para extraer información masiva sobre millones de personas.

Según explicó, esto representa un cambio de naturaleza en el problema, porque ya no se trataría de herramientas que los humanos ajustan y perfeccionan, sino de sistemas con capacidad de autosuperación.
¿Qué pasa si la IA pierde control sobre sí misma? Según Coxon, el riesgo es que estos sistemas desarrollen objetivos no previstos y que ninguna empresa del sector cuente hoy con mecanismos para impedirlo, lo que podría derivar en un escenario de pérdida de control humano sobre la tecnología.
“En mi opinión, si seguimos por el camino actual, hay más probabilidades de que la humanidad pierda el control de estas IA que de que lo mantenga, y eso podría acabar en la extinción humana”, aseveró ante el Concejo. El exinvestigador precisó que las compañías de IA buscan desarrollar sistemas “capaces de superar a los humanos en todas las tareas”.

Los 219 choques de 2025 superaron en más de tres veces los 69 de 2024

Pendant plus d'un an, des collèges, des lycées et des collectivités du département du Tarn ont vécu au rythme des fausses alertes à la bombe et des faits de swatting, sans que personne ne parvienne à mettre un nom sur leurs auteurs. En fait, il n'y en avait qu'un ! Et ce dernier comptait sur un banal réseau privé virtuel (VPN) pour masquer son adresse IP, et donc son identité. Il n'avait pas prévu que plusieurs unités cyber de la gendarmerie, du Tarn jusqu'à l'échelon national, finiraient par se pencher sur son cas.
Comment les gendarmes ont démasqué un jeune caché derrière un VPN
C'est donc entre mars 2025 et juin 2026, que plusieurs collèges, lycées et collectivités territoriales du Tarn, en particulier dans le secteur de Gaillac, ont été la cible de treize fausses alertes à la bombe et de swatting. Ce mot vient des SWAT, les unités d'intervention d'élite de la police américaine. Le swatting consiste en fait à signaler un faux crime violent en cours, comme une prise d'otages ou une fusillade, pour que des forces d'intervention lourdement équipées débarquent en urgence chez une victime qui n'a rien demandé. Cómo funciona la marca invisible
La tecnología se llama textGrain y añade una señal estadística imperceptible en la elección de palabras que hace el modelo al redactar un texto. Un detector propio de OpenAI puede luego analizar un fragmento y estimar si fue generado con sus sistemas.
La empresa explicó que los clientes que usan su interfaz de programación (API) en cualquier país del mundo pueden activar esa marca de manera opcional para determinados modelos. La función permanece desactivada por defecto y queda a criterio de cada desarrollador.
Por ahora, el acceso al detector no es público. OpenAI abrió una convocatoria para que investigadores y organizaciones especializadas soliciten permiso de uso, en línea con el Código de Prácticas de la Unión Europea sobre transparencia de contenido generado con inteligencia artificial, que la compañía firmó en junio.

El gobierno de Noruega anunció que presentará ante el Parlamento un proyecto de ley para prohibir de forma temporaria el uso de anteojos con inteligencia artificial en determinados espacios públicos, por temor a que las personas sean fotografiadas, filmadas o grabadas sin saberlo.
El ministro noruego de Digitalización y Gobernanza Pública, Torgeir Micaelsen, dijo que le preocupa que se introduzca “tecnología poderosa donde la gente corre el riesgo de ser fotografiada, filmada o grabada sin saberlo”.
La prohibición temporaria podría aplicarse en lugares donde la gente se junta habitualmente: parques, playas, museos, centros comerciales y eventos públicos, según el comunicado oficial del gobierno.
También alcanzaría a espacios donde se congregan menores, como escuelas, jardines de infantes, plazas de juegos y clubes juveniles, y a sitios considerados especialmente sensibles para la privacidad, como consultorios médicos, piscinas y gimnasios con vestuarios.
El alcance de una prohibición parcial
El propio gobierno aclaró que no busca una prohibición total de los anteojos con inteligencia artificial ni de otra tecnología que se usa en el cuerpo. El uso privado seguiría permitido, y se evalúan excepciones para grupos vulnerables que puedan beneficiarse de la tecnología.
Todavía falta definir qué dispositivos entrarían en la norma. El ejecutivo noruego dijo que analizará si la restricción cubre anteojos con cámara y grabación de audio, anteojos con cámara y funciones de inteligencia…
